name: Lipoprotein-linked amyloid-beta clearance and glial activation
rationale: Members concern amyloid-beta formation and clearance, apoptotic-cell clearance and glial/microglial activation; unlike the microglia-centred confusables the theme carries lipoprotein particle signaling and oxidised-LDL response.

name: Erythroid-megakaryocyte differentiation and platelet formation
rationale: All members describe the erythroid-megakaryocytic branch (RUNX1/TAL1-GFI1B control, red cell and megakaryocyte development, platelet morphogenesis), distinguishing it from erythroid-only and granulocytic/myeloid-progenitor confusables.

name: Viral receptor attachment, entry and membrane fusion
rationale: Members cover receptor-mediated virion attachment, endocytic entry and envelope-driven cell-cell fusion across dengue, RSV, influenza and HIV, whereas confusables emphasise regulation of entry, viral transport or viral protein maturation.

name: Regulation of pri- and pre-miRNA processing
rationale: All three members regulate the nuclear and cytoplasmic processing steps of miRNA maturation, unlike confusables about miRNA silencing, RISC assembly or miRNA degradation.

core: Dietary sugar digestion and hexose transport
name: Dietary sugar digestion and hexose transmembrane transport
rationale: Members cover disaccharide digestion, intestinal hexose absorption and SLC2/SLC5 hexose-transporter defects, distinguishing the theme from urate transport, galactose/fructose catabolism and glycoside transport confusables.

name: Cellular senescence and p53-dependent intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members span oncogene-, stress- and replicative senescence (p16/ARF, SAHF, SASP) and p53-driven transcription of intrinsic apoptotic genes, while confusables centre on BCL-2/apoptosome execution, extrinsic death or p53 phosphorylation and G2 checkpoint.

name: Histone and DNA methylation in epigenetic gene silencing
rationale: Members are histone lysine/arginine methylation and demethylation, DNA/CpG methylation and their silencing outcomes (imprinting, X inactivation, facultative heterochromatin), unlike CHD/NuRD/HDAC remodeling confusables.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and mRNA stability
rationale: Members regulate mitochondrial transcription initiation/termination and mitochondrial mRNA processing, stability and decay, distinguishing them from mtDNA replication/repair and mitochondrial translation confusables.

name: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kB signaling via TNF-family receptors
rationale: Members cover IKK/NIK activation, linear ubiquitination and NF-kB regulation downstream of TNFR1, CD40 and TNFSF receptors, unlike confusables focused on lymphocyte antigen-receptor or TLR/TRIF routes to NF-kB.

name: Inositol phosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis
rationale: All members concern synthesis of inositol phosphates and diphosphoinositol polyphosphates, unrelated to the PTEN, nucleotide or NUDT confusables.

name: Immunoglobulin diversification and stimulated CD4 T cell proliferation
rationale: Members combine V(D)J recombination, somatic hypermutation, class switching and B cell commitment with modules of dividing stimulated CD4 T cells, the latter absent from the APOBEC/HIV and mismatch-repair confusables.

name: Cholesterol-to-bile acid synthesis and peroxisomal side-chain oxidation
rationale: Members describe hydroxycholesterol routes to bile acids and their peroxisomal beta-oxidation step, whereas confusables cover bile acid transport/signaling, vitamin E or intestinal lipid absorption.

name: Epithelial amino acid and urate transmembrane transport
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane SLC transport of neutral amino acids, cystine and urate and their renal transport disorders, distinguished from organic cation, oligopeptide and hexose transport confusables.

name: Regulation of ubiquitin-dependent proteasomal protein turnover
rationale: Members positively and negatively regulate ubiquitin-dependent proteolysis and protein destabilization, unlike confusables about ERAD/misfolded-protein quality control, degron pathways, chaperone folding or stress granules.

qualifier: coupled to DNA repair and replication
name: Nucleosome remodeling coupled to DNA repair and replication
rationale: Members concern nucleosome assembly/disassembly and chromatin binding during replication and repair (including ADP-ribosylation and NER regulation), whereas confusables are transcriptional BAF, NuRD or CHD6-9 remodeling.

name: Ischemic and peroxide stress responses regulating ferroptosis
rationale: Members cover responses to ischemia, oxygen-glucose deprivation and peroxides together with ferroptosis regulation, distinguishing them from ROS detoxification, nitrosative stress and respiration-control confusables.

name: CaMK-CREB signaling in synaptic plasticity and memory
rationale: Members link postsynaptic calcium and CaMK/CAMKK cascades to CREB phosphorylation, LTP/LTD and memory, unlike confusables centred on PKA/MECP2, structural plasticity or glutamate-receptor signaling.

qualifier: thiamine, riboflavin and CoA cofactor supply
name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase and thiamine, riboflavin, CoA cofactor supply
rationale: Members cover pyruvate decarboxylation to acetyl-CoA plus the B1, B2 and pantothenate/CoA cofactors it needs, distinguishing it from NAD, cobalamin/biotin and other 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase confusables.

name: cGAS-STING regulation of interferon-beta and CCL5 production
rationale: Members regulate cGAS/STING, cGAMP import, IFN-beta and CCL5/dendritic cell cytokine output, whereas confusables cover RIG-I/TLR sensing and downstream interferon-stimulated gene responses.

name: Epithelial adherens junction assembly and apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members concern cadherin-based adherens junctions and epithelial apical-basal polarity, unlike desmosome/hemidesmosome, cardiac adhesion or CDH1 trafficking confusables.

qualifier: migration and proliferation in vessel remodeling
name: Vascular smooth muscle migration and proliferation in vessel remodeling
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle migration, proliferation, dedifferentiation and vessel remodeling/wound healing, while confusables emphasise phenotypic switching, differentiation and apoptosis.

name: K48/K11 deubiquitination by OTU proteases and PKR signaling
rationale: Members are OTU-family K48/K11 deubiquitination and its regulation plus PKR-linked kinase inhibition, the latter absent from the K63/USP/metalloprotease DUB confusables.

qualifier: neutrophil and T cell, endothelial adhesion
name: Leukocyte adhesion to endothelium and neutrophil/T cell extravasation
rationale: Members regulate leukocyte-endothelial adhesion, integrin-mediated migration and diapedesis of neutrophils and T cells, unlike shear-stress, PECAM1 or monocyte-centred confusables.

name: Regulation of metanephric kidney growth and size
rationale: All members regulate the extent of metanephric kidney development and organ size, versus confusables on nephron proliferation, ureteric/mesonephric morphogenesis or mesenchymal differentiation.

name: Tubular endoplasmic reticulum membrane shaping
rationale: All members concern formation and regulation of the tubular ER membrane network, unrelated to the organelle transport and ER lipid-transfer confusables.
